pairs: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, de sermonibus siccitatis.
The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the words of the drought.
and become hard to discern on the ground.
And the outcry of Jerusalem has ascended.
Majores miserunt minores suos ad aquam:
The greater ones have sent their lesser ones to the water.
they carried their vessels back empty.
and so they covered their heads.
Because of the devastation of the earth,
quia non venit pluvia in terram,
because rain did not fall upon the earth,
Nam et cerva in agro peperit,
For even the doe has given birth in the field,
And the wild donkeys stood upon the rocks;
like dragons, they drew in the wind,
if our iniquities have responded against us,
let it be for the sake of your name.
its Savior in time of tribulation,
quare quasi colonus futurus es in terra,
why would you be like a sojourner in the land,
et quasi viator declinans ad manendum?
and like a traveler turning aside for lodging?
quare futurus es velut vir vagus,
Why would you be like a wandering man,
ut fortis qui non potest salvare? Tu autem in nobis es,
like a strong man who is unable to save? But you,
et nomen tuum invocatum est super nos:
are with us, and your name is invoked over us,
Thus says the Lord to this people,
who have loved to move their feet,
but who have not pleased the Lord:
and now he will visit against their sins.”
And the Lord said to me:
Noli orare pro populo isto in bonum.
“Do not choose to pray for this people for good.
I will not heed their petitions.
et si obtulerint holocautomata et victimas,
And if they offer holocausts and victims,
For I will consume them by the sword,
The prophets are saying to them:
et fames non erit in vobis:
and there will be no famine among you.
sed pacem veram dabit vobis in loco isto.
Instead, he will give you true peace in this place.’”
And the Lord said to me:
Falso prophetæ vaticinantur in nomine meo: non misi eos,
“The prophets prophesy falsely in my name. I did not send them,
and I did not instruct them,
and I have not spoken to them.
They prophesy to you a lying vision,
et seductionem cordis sui, prophetant vobis.
and a fraud, and a seduction from their own heart.
Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus de prophetis qui prophetant in nomine meo,
For this reason, thus says the Lord about the prophets who prophesy in my name,
Gladius et fames non erit in terra hac:
‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’
In gladio et fame consumentur prophetæ illi.
By sword and famine those prophets will be consumed.
Et populi quibus prophetant erunt projecti in viis Jerusalem præ fame
et non erit qui sepeliat eos:
will be cast into the streets of Jerusalem,
due to famine and the sword,
and there will be no one who may bury them,
et effundam super eos malum suum.
and I will pour out their own evil upon them.
Et dices ad eos verbum istud:
And you shall speak this word to them:
Deducant oculi mei lacrimam per noctem et diem,
Let my eyes shed tears throughout the night and day,
quoniam contritione magna contrita est virgo filia populi mei,
For the virgin daughter of my people has been crushed by a great affliction,
“If I go out into the fields: behold,
And if I enter into the city: behold, those weakened by famine.
Propheta quoque et sacerdos abierunt in terram quam ignorabant.
and the priest, have gone into a land that they did not know.
Could you have utterly cast out Judah?
aut Sion abominata est anima tua?
Or has your soul abhorred Zion?
quare ergo percussisti nos ita ut nulla sit sanitas?
Then why have you struck us, so much so that there is no health for us?
and for the time of healing,
that we have sinned against you.
For the sake of your name,
propter nomen tuum, neque facias nobis contumeliam solii gloriæ tuæ:
do not give us over into disgrace. And do not dishonor in us the throne of your glory.
ne irritum facias fœdus tuum nobiscum.
do not make void, your covenant with us.
Numquid sunt in sculptilibus gentium qui pluant?
Could any of the graven images of the Gentiles send rain?
Or are the heavens able to give showers?
nonne tu es Dominus Deus noster,
Have we not hoped in you,
For you have made all these things.”
